caption: A paint roller, dipped in green paint, is used to cover a section of a metal fence, creating a uniform green coat.
first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A paint roller, dipped in green paint, is used to cover a section of a metal fence, creating a uniform green coat. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The paint roller must be fully saturated with green paint before application.
The roller must be rolled in a consistent, overlapping motion across the metal fence surface.
The paint must be applied evenly to ensure a uniform green coat without visible streaks or gaps.
The roller must be re-dipped in paint as needed to maintain consistent coverage during the process.
